title: Shiki-Sai Fireworks Dining Package | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Shiki-Sai: Sushi Izakaya Fireworks Dining Package Located in World Showcase at EPCOT Enjoy a feast for the senses, with a delicious sushi izakaya meal and dazzling views of the nighttime fireworks show at EPCOT. Dining Events Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. To book, check back starting August 27, 2026. Advance reservations are highly recommended.Sushi, Sashimi and a Sparkling ShowSavor a flavorful finale at Shiki-Sai: Sushi Izakaya! Book a fireworks dining package that features a thoughtfully curated menu of Japanese cuisine, including:An appetizerTraditional sashimiAn extensive selection of sushiAn exclusive dessert and beverages available only with this packageWhile you dine, enjoy shimmering views of World Showcase Lagoon. Then, watch the sky come alive during Luminous The Symphony of Us—a nighttime spectacular with fireworks, fountains, music and light.Know Before You GoPriceAges 10+: $120 per person, plus tax and gratuity ($149.50 total, including tax and gratuity) Ages 3 to 9: $60 per person, plus tax and gratuity ($74.70 total, including tax and gratuity)ReservationsAdvance reservations are highly recommended. Same-day reservations can be made on a limited basis and are subject to availability.Learn when advance reservations can be made.Check-In TimePlease arrive at Shiki-Sai: Sushi Izakaya at your designated check-in time—60 minutes prior to Luminous The Symphony of Us. This dining experience lasts approximately 60 minutes, concluding when the show ends.FireworksFireworks are not guaranteed as part of this experience; on rare occasions, evening fireworks may be rescheduled or cancelled. Please refer to the entertainment schedule to confirm showtimes 2 weeks prior to your reservation, and check again the day of your reservation.Beverage PolicyGuests must be at least 21 years of age or older to consume alcoholic beverages. Please keep a valid form of identification on hand at all times to verify your age.Subject to ChangeAll menu items and prices are subject to change, and the experience may be changed or cancelled without prior notice.ModificationsThis experience does not allow modifications once the reservation is confirmed. Learn more.CancellationsThere is a 24-hour cancellation policy. Full price will be charged/forfeited if the Guest cancels within one day or fails to show up for the reservation.Related ActivitiesRose & Crown Fireworks Dining PackageSavor classic British fare served lakeside—with fantastic fireworks views.Spice Road Table Fireworks Dining PackageTake your taste buds to Morocco for delish dishes and a sparkling nighttime show.Fireworks & Nighttime EntertainmentCap off your day with a dazzling display of fireworks, lights and shimmering sights.
